description: Update use case fields for a blueprint. Updates the use case linked to the specified blueprint. Propagates staleness to the blueprint.

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

sections.description: Fields to update. Common keys: title, description, businessChallenge, description5Ws, currentPainPoints, desiredBusinessOutcomes, processDocumentation, transformationStory, typedSuccessMetrics, organizationalConstraints, affectedDepartments. Unknown keys are accepted but only mapped fields are persisted.

name: update_use_case
